01 · 8th Anniversary

A new director takes over

Lee Byeong-tak succeeded Jeon Jae-hak and hosted the stream on his first day as director. He acknowledged the concerns around the game and used the anniversary stream to answer questions about progression transfers and the direction of Lost Ark.

He plans to host updates himself and communicate more often through streams, letters, notices, and in-game channels. The team has already been asked to build a system for in-game communication.

02 · Progression

What carries into Part 2?

Part 2 starts with the story moving to the Sea of Aldebaran. It covers a bigger span than a numbered season. Future releases will use subtitles.

SystemTransfer plan
BraceletsTop-end bracelets transfer to the top end of the new system. Slot-based stats are designed to be hard to replace, with a similar investment in attempts, time and effort. The stated goal is to preserve their value for at least a year.
AccessoriesTriple-high accessories transfer close to the top end. Remaining trades carry over. Using the item in the new system binds it.
HoningExisting honing progression and materials carry over. A higher honing stage is planned for summer 2027, with gear transfer at that point.
Quality & KarmaStones of Chaos and Stones of Destiny are also slated for conversion into materials for the new systems.
Bound Lv. 8 GemsThe announced choice is to keep a bound Lv. 8 Gem or exchange it for a tradeable Lv. 7 Gem.
Bound Lv. 7 GemsExisting Lv. 7 Gems stay bound.

The director said the transfer was the original design. Part 2 adds gear slots, new progression systems, and new places to spend Gold. The aim is to give players clearer goals at each step while keeping max rolls difficult to reach.

November 20 stream · The team plans to show the progression UI and transfer tables.
03 · Economy

Bound Gold for alts beyond the six

Starting in Part 2, characters outside your roster’s six designated Gold earners can earn Bound Gold from eligible endgame content.

The director used 9,000–10,000 Combat Power as an example of expensive progression that still leads to the same Nightmare raid as a character at 7,000–8,000. The team wants more milestones to justify those upgrades.

Solo progression

New solo challenges give players goals they can tackle at their own pace and return to after gearing up.

Raid and daily rewards

Group raids remain central, with stronger rewards planned for party raids and Nightmare. Players at different progression levels could receive different reward amounts or bound proportions from the same daily activity.

04 · Combat

Multi-Crit & class balance

Multi-Crit gives Crit Rate above 100% a use while keeping Crit Damage and existing Crit builds relevant. The example on stream used a base hit of 1 and 350% Crit Damage. A regular crit would hit for 3.5 and a Multi-Crit would hit for 6.0.

  • November 18. Multi-Crit balance, Support improvements, and numerical tuning. Paradise Legacy effects are being adjusted to reduce Crit-related advantages in Paradise and its competitive content.
  • Blunt Thorn. The Ark Passive Evolution node’s Crit Rate cap is slated to come off, with a lower conversion coefficient.
  • December winter update. The larger class balance pass is targeted for winter.
  • Kazeros Extreme. The director said the team had too little time for an immediate nerf or balance pass.
05 · Weekly Content

World Boss damage competition

The new World Boss is planned as a weekly activity with multiple time slots. You queue through an entry UI at a specific location, similar to a Chaos Gate. Teams compete on damage.

  • Teams get one of five colors. If the winning team shares your color, your team also gets the associated reward.
  • The last-hit bonus is awarded to the team.
  • Enter in a premade party or play alongside your guild based on the party leader. Random matchmaking is also available.
06 · Player Progression

Early game, midgame, and endgame

  • New and casual players. The winter update is targeting reworked Powerpasses and Express Events. The team is also looking at simpler early honing, clearer onboarding, and preset-style builds.
  • Midgame players. The team wants more intermediate goals, activities outside of raids, and MMO content that brings more players together.
  • Endgame players. The priorities are stronger rewards for progression, more endgame goals, and clearer communication when plans change or a problem needs fixing.

08 · Character Names

Character name reset & lottery

The KR reset covers characters at item level 1640 or below on accounts inactive for at least one year, down from the earlier two-year threshold. The team is also looking to free up names from permanently banned accounts. It estimated more than 10 million names would be available based on the announcement snapshot.

The lottery gives one ticket for Part 2 preregistration and up to two more based on the account’s highest item level. If a character created with a winning name is deleted, the name is reclaimed. Names that go unclaimed in the lottery become available for regular registration or name changes from December 23.
